title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Job Type: Full-time Experience Level: Senior (5+ Years)

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist to lead our data initiatives and drive significant business impact through advanced analytics and machine learning. In this role, you will not only build complex models but also act as a technical mentor to junior team members and a strategic partner to business stakeholders. You will be responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of machine learning products, from conceptualization to deployment and monitoring in production.

Key Responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Strategy: Lead the design and development of scalable machine learning solutions. Define the technical roadmap for data projects and ensure alignment with broader business goals.

Advanced Modeling: Architect and implement state-of-the-art algorithms (Deep Learning, NLP, Reinforcement Learning, etc.) to solve highly complex and ambiguous business problems.

Mentorship & Code Quality: Mentor junior and mid-level data scientists, conduct code reviews, and establish best practices for coding standards, reproducibility, and experimentation.

End-to-End MLOps: Champion the transition of models from notebook prototypes to production-grade systems. Collaborate with Data Engineers to build robust data pipelines and automated training workflows (CI/CD for ML).

Stakeholder Management: Translate complex data findings into actionable strategic recommendations for executive leadership and non-technical partners. Influence business decisions using data-driven storytelling.

Innovation: Stay up-to-date with the latest research and technologies in AI/ML and identify opportunities to apply them to improve our products and processes.

Qualifications
Education: Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.

Experience: 5+ years of relevant industry experience in data science, machine learning, or predictive analytics.

Programming Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow) and SQL (writing optimized complex queries).

Production Experience: Proven track record of deploying machine learning models into production environments (API development using FastAPI/Flask, Dockerization).

Cloud Proficiency: Extensive experience with cloud ecosystems (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and their AI/ML services (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI).

Big Data: Hands-on experience processing massive datasets using distributed computing frameworks (Spark, Databricks, Hadoop).

Preferred Qualifications (The "Senior" Edge)
Experience designing A/B testing frameworks and causal inference methodologies.

Strong knowledge of MLOps tools (MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, Jenkins).

Experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j) or Vector Databases (Pinecone, Milvus) for GenAI applications.

Published research papers or contributions to open-source data science projects.

Tech Stack
Core: Python, SQL, PySpark

ML Frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face

Infrastructure: AWS/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes

Workflow: Airflow, MLflow, Git

Viz: Tableau, Looker, Streamlit

Benefits
[Competitive Senior-level Salary & Equity/Stock Options]

[Health Insurance / Group Insurance]

[Flexible working hours / Remote work options]

[Annual Learning Budget for Conferences and Certifications]

Key Differences from the Junior/Mid-level JD:
Mentorship: Explicitly requires guiding others.

Production Focus: Shifts from just "building models" to "deploying and maintaining" them (MLOps).

Strategy: Requires defining the roadmap and influencing business decisions, not just answering questions.

Complexity: Handles ambiguous problems rather than well-defined tasks.
